_comment: Hand-added dependencies merged into GENERATED target blocks by
scripts/gen-buck-from-ninja.py. They live here rather than inside the block,
because --write replaces a block wholesale and would drop them.
Almost all of these are frameworks and codegen. The reference build puts all
141 frameworks on every Darwin compile's include path; this port makes each
target name the ones it actually includes, so a target cannot silently start
depending on a framework it never declared.
